title: The heaviest thing you’re carrying right now isn’t your burden—it’s the uncertainty of what happens next.
paragraphs: The heaviest thing you’re carrying right now isn’t your burden—it’s the uncertainty of what happens next.

We try so hard to outrun the storm or fight the chaos on our own strength. But look at this image. The Gospel Warrior doesn't find peace by escaping the clouds; he finds it by kneeling in the midst of them, right where the Light breaks through.
Stop trying to figure it all out. Your mind was not designed to hold the weight of the future. Take that uncertainty into His presence. It’s the only bunker that can withstand the blast.
Where the world sees a storm, faith sees an altar. drop a 🔥 if you are handing your battles over to Him today. Let's rise together.
⚔️ "God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble." – Psalm 46:1
